card.name: The word interaction in drug labels
card.fires_on: The word "interaction" or "interactions", including its first piece "Inter", in drug-label text about drug-drug interactions. It also fires once on "temperature" after "optimum".

modes.label: Whole word
modes.description: The full word interaction(s) after a, an, this or specific.
modes.example: There have been reports that an<< interaction>> exists when fluconazole is administered con

modes.label: Split word
modes.description: The start or end of the word broken into pieces, as in Inter-actions, in table titles.
modes.example: Table 3. Clinically Significant<< Inter>>actions Affecting Other Drugs CYP
